subject: Discovery follow-up: Next steps + schedule demo / technical deep dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpath.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finpath.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: Next steps + schedule demo / technical deep dive

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Goals from your side: reduce inference cost on customer-facing flows, improve 95th percentile latency to <300ms, and get predictable capacity for high-volume batch jobs.
- Constraints: must pass security review (SOC2, audit logs) and integrate with your platform’s VPC.

Next steps I propose:
1) Technical deep-dive / demo (45–60 min) to walk your engineering team through our runtime, KV/cache behavior, and deployment options.
2) Security sync with Neha to go through our SOC2 scope and architecture.
3) Procurement/contract discussion (short call) to align on timeline and MPA items.

Available slots for the technical deep-dive next week: Mon 10/19 10:00–11:00 PT, Tue 10/20 13:00–14:00 PT, Wed 10/21 15:00–16:00 PT. If none of those work, please propose 2–3 times or hit my Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-co/30min

Looping in Neha (security) and Dev (platform) to join the technical call and answer network/VPC questions. I’ve attached our SOC2 report and a high-level architecture diagram for your security team to skim ahead of time.

Attachments: SOC2-report-2025.pdf, redwood-architecture.png

Thanks — looking forward to continuing this.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finpath.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: Next steps + schedule demo / technical deep dive

Hey Marissa —

Great recap, thanks. We’re excited to explore Redwood for low-latency scored features in our lending product. Quick notes from our side:
- Team that should join the deep-dive: myself (platform), Priya (procurement), and our engineering leads: Daniel Park and Rosa Kim (I’ll loop them into the invite once the time is confirmed).
- Security wants to review SOC2 and a short questionnaire — Priya is our procurement lead but will coordinate security redlines with our InfoSec.

From your proposed slots, Tue 10/20 13:00–14:00 PT works for us.

Also — Priya, can you confirm whether FinPath needs a redlined MPA or if a standard SOW is fine for an initial pilot?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Director, Platform Engineering | FinPath
alex.johnson@finpath.com | +1 312-555-4490

Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Discovery follow-up: Next steps + schedule demo / technical deep dive

Forwarding Alex’s note and locking in Tue 10/20 13:00–14:00 PT for the technical deep-dive.

Neha / Dev / Vivek — can you join? High-level agenda:
- 10 min: product recap and key success metrics for pilot (cost/latency targets)
- 25 min: runtime deep-dive (KV cache, batching, quantization options) + network/VPC requirements
- 10 min: security Qs and next steps for procurement (MPA/SOW)

Neha: Alex mentioned security will want to review SOC2 and a short questionnaire. I attached a draft security questionnaire specific to FinPath and the SOC2 we shared earlier. Can you review and flag anything we should pre-answer before Tue?

Priya: can you advise what procurement docs FinPath needs for an initial pilot (redline MPA vs SOW)? If easier, we can do a separate 20-min procurement sync the week after the demo.

Attachments: security-questionnaire-finpath.docx

If you prefer a different time, let me know — otherwise I’ll send a calendar invite with Zoom and the agenda.

Thanks all,
—
Marissa

Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: Next steps + schedule demo / technical deep dive

Hi all —

I can join Tue 10/20 13:00–14:00 PT. Thanks for sharing the SOC2 and questionnaire — I skimmed both and added a few quick asks below so we can address during the demo or ahead of time: 

1) Data flows: please confirm whether any customer PII flows into Redwood logs by default and our retention TTLs for request/response logs. We should prepare a short diagram of log retention and access controls.
2) Network: are you planning a VPC peering or private endpoint? Dev/Vivek, please be ready to outline network requirements and hostnames/IPs needed for allowlisting.
3) Encryption: confirm if we need to provide a KMS key from FinPath for encryption-at-rest or if we can integrate with your KMS later in the pilot.

I’ll draft concise responses in <24 hours and attach an updated questionnaire. If any of these are blockers for your InfoSec, let me know now so we can prioritize.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
